notes.title: Conduits is Going Free-to-Play in 2025
notes.content: In January of next year I will be making conduits free to play on Steam. I have chosen to do this because I want as many people as possible to be able to experience the nostalgia of Conduits. While the current price barrier of $1.99 is small, it is still a barrier none the less. I want to open up this little project to anyone who has the spare space on their hard drive. Thank you to everyone who has chosen to spend their money on this little passion project of mine.

notes.title: Conduits Workshop Update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now use the Conduits Steam workshop to download and upload presets!
[*] To upload a preset, enter the scene and press escape. Enter your preset name and click "Upload to Workshop"
[*] To download a workshop preset, subscribe to it and then start Conduts. It should show up in your Presets menu.
[*] If it doesn't show up, try verifying your Conduits game files in your Steam library.
[*] To delete a workshop preset, unsubscribe from it in the workshop, then delete it from your Presets menu.
[/list]
